channel.title: Nature Materials
channel.description: Nature Materials is a multidisciplinary journal aimed at bringing together cutting-edge research across the entire spectrum of materials science and technology. Nature Materials covers all applied and fundamental aspects of the synthesis/processing, structure/composition, properties and performance of materials. Nature Materials provides a forum for the development of a common identity among materials scientists while encouraging researchers to cross established subdisciplinary lines. To achieve this, Nature Materials takes an interdisciplinary, integrated and balanced approach to all areas of materials research while fostering the exchange of ideas between scientists involved in different communities.

item.title: [8] Electrical control of perpendicular altermagnets
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Mingzhong Wu

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Altermagnetism and Dirac semimetals are highly relevant to the user's research interests.

Tags: #altermagnet #Diracsemimetal #heterostructure

Abstract: An altermagnet/Dirac semimetal heterostructure enables electrical switching and reading of an altermagnetic Néel vector oriented perpendicular to the film, a configuration previously forbidden by magnetic symmetry.

item.title: [8] Interlayer hybridization promotes superconductivity in bilayer nickelates
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Yi Lu, Yingying Peng

Authors: Shilong Zhang, Meng Zhang, Qiling Luo, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Nickelate superconductivity is a key interest; spectroscopic study relevant to experimentalists.

Tags: #nickelates #spectroscopy #superconductivity

Abstract: Spectroscopic studies on a series of bilayer nickelate (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 thin films with insulating, metallic and superconducting ground states are presented and it is concluded that superconductivity emerges when coherent $${d}_{{z}^{2}}-{p}_{z}-{d}_{{z}^{2}}$$ d z 2 - p z - d z 2 interlayer hybridization develops.
